final_text:
Yes — I added note attachments support.

What changed:
- Added backend storage and database support for files attached to notes
- Added API routes to:
  - upload a file to a note
  - list files for a note
  - download an attached file
  - delete an attached file
- Added frontend API helpers for note attachments
- Updated shared types to include note file metadata
- Updated the README to mention attachments

How it works:
- Upload a file from inside a note
- The file is stored on the server and linked to that note
- Later you can open the note and download the attached file again

One caveat:
- I wasn’t able to run a full build in this container because the project dependencies aren’t installed here (`vite` was not found).
